# pve_firewall_ipset_entry (Resource)

One CIDR entry (with comment/nomatch) inside a firewall IP set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_firewall_ipset_entry" "example" {
cidr = "CHANGE_ME"
name = "CHANGE_ME"
scope = "cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Network/IP specification in CIDR format.
- `name` (String) IP set name.
- `scope` (String) One of: `cluster`, `vm`, `container`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) <string>
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `nomatch` (Boolean) <boolean>
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: scope/node/vmid/name/cidr (also the `terraform import` format).
